name: create_domain
description: Designs and creates a new user domain. LLM proposes a schema. User reviews, optionally adds tables, and confirms. DDL is executed, CRUD workflows are generated, entity schemas are registered, and the domain is immediately usable from /mind.

steps.description: Derive candidate domain slug from user input for duplicate pre-check.

steps.description: Domain already exists. Offer recreate (overwrite registration) or cancel.

steps.description: RIGHT BRAIN: Research domain data-modelling best practices and surface structural preference questions before schema design.
Build preference_gates array from right brain research output.
steps.expression: (function() { var letters = ['A','B','C','D','E']; return (items.preference_questions || []).map(function(q) { var opts = (q.options || []).map(function(o, i) { return { value: o.value, label: letters[i] || String.fromCharCode(65+i), description: o.description || '', on_select: 'next' }; }); opts.push({ value: 'na', label: 'N/A', description: 'Not applicable to my use case', on_select: 'next' }); opts.push({ value: 'cancel', label: 'Cancel', description: '', on_select: 'cancel' }); return { id: q.id, question: q.question, rationale: q.rationale || '', options: opts }; }); })()

Enrich each table with columnSummary and domain field.
steps.expression: (function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); function enrich(tables, domain) {  return tables.map(function(t) {   if (!t.columns) return t;   var cols = t.columns.filter(function(c){ return !SYS.has(c.name); }).slice(0,4).map(function(c){ return c.name; });   return Object.assign({}, t, { columnSummary: cols.join(', '), domain: domain });  }); } return enrich(items, local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain); })()

(function() { var SYS = ['id','created_at','updated_at']; var tables = local_state.proposed_scaffold && local_state.proposed_scaffold.tables || []; var domain = local_state.proposed_scaffold && local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain || ''; var summaryLines = ['*' + domain + ' — ' + tables.length + ' table' + (tables.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ':*']; tables.forEach(function(t) { summaryLines.push('• *' + t.tableName + '* — ' + (t.columnSummary || '')); }); var schema_summary = summaryLines.join('
'); var table_review_items = tables.map(function(t) {  var cols = (t.columns || []).filter(function(c) { return SYS.indexOf(c.name) === -1; });  var colLines = cols.map(function(c) {   var l = c.name + ' (' + (c.type || 'text') + ')';   if (c.description) l = l + ' — ' + c.description;   return '• ' + l;  });  var content = (t.description ? t.description + '

' : '') + 'Columns:

');  return { button_label: t.tableName, content: content }; }); return { schema_summary: schema_summary, table_review_items: table_review_items };})()

steps.description: LEFT BRAIN: Revise domain schema based on user feedback.
LLM designs the new table from user description.
Merge new_table, apply existing_table_modifications, topological sort so FK targets precede referencing tables, re-enrich. Loops back to step 3.
steps.expression: (function() { var SYS = new Set(['id','created_at','updated_at']); function enrich(tables, domain) {  return tables.map(function(t) {   if (!t.columns) return t;   var cols = t.columns.filter(function(c){ return !SYS.has(c.name); }).slice(0,4).map(function(c){ return c.name; });   return Object.assign({}, t, { columnSummary: cols.join(', '), domain: domain });  }); } function topoSort(tables) {  var nameToTable = {};  tables.forEach(function(t) { nameToTable[t.tableName] = t; });  var deps = {};  tables.forEach(function(t) {   var d = [];   (t.foreignKeys || []).forEach(function(fk) {    var ref = fk.references && fk.references.table;    if (ref && nameToTable[ref] && ref !== t.tableName) d.push(ref);   });   deps[t.tableName] = d;  });  var result = [], visited = {}, inStack = {};  function visit(name) {   if (visited[name]) return;   if (inStack[name]) return;   inStack[name] = true;   (deps[name] || []).forEach(visit);   inStack[name] = false;   visited[name] = true;   if (nameToTable[name]) result.push(nameToTable[name]);  }  tables.forEach(function(t) { visit(t.tableName); });  return result; } var newTable = local_state.new_table; var domain = local_state.proposed_scaffold.domain; var mods = (newTable && Array.isArray(newTable.existing_table_modifications))   ? newTable.existing_table_modifications : []; var patched = items.map(function(t) {  var mod = mods.find(function(m) { return m.tableName === t.tableName; });  if (!mod) return t;  var extraCols = Array.isArray(mod.add_columns) ? mod.add_columns : [];  var extraFKs  = Array.isArray(mod.add_foreign_keys) ? mod.add_foreign_keys : [];  return Object.assign({}, t, {   columns:     (t.columns || []).concat(extraCols),   foreignKeys: (t.foreignKeys || []).concat(extraFKs)  }); }); var cleanNew = null; if (newTable) {  cleanNew = Object.assign({}, newTable);  delete cleanNew.existing_table_modifications; } var merged = cleanNew ? patched.concat([cleanNew]) : patched; var ordered = topoSort(merged); return enrich(ordered, domain);})()

steps.description: Final confirmation before DDL execution.

steps.description: Create each confirmed PGD table via SERV-Schema createTable.
Derive domain registration data deterministically from confirmed scaffold — no LLM.
steps.expression: (() => { const domain = items.domain; const tables = items.tables; function toEntityName(d) { const words = d.split('_'); const titled = words.map(w => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1)); const last = titled[titled.length - 1]; if (last.endsWith('s') && last.length > 2) titled[titled.length - 1] = last.slice(0, -1); return titled.join(''); } const entityName = toEntityName(domain); const words = domain.split('_'); const aliases = Array.from(new Set([domain, domain.replace(/_/g, ' '), entityName.toLowerCase(), words[words.length - 1]])); const domainHelp = { domain, aliases, description: 'Manage your ' + domain.replace(/_/g, ' ') + ' data', commands: [ { syntax: '/m list ' + domain, description: 'List all records' }, { syntax: '/m get ' + domain + ' <name or id>', description: 'Find a specific record' }, { syntax: '/m add ' + domain + ' <description>', description: 'Add a new record' }, { syntax: '/m update ' + domain + ' id=<n> <field>=<value>', description: 'Update a record' }, { syntax: '/m delete ' + domain + ' id=<n>', description: 'Delete a record' } ] }; const intentMapRows = [ { pattern: 'add.' + domain + '|add ' + domain + '|add my ' + domain, intent_category: 'add_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'list.' + domain + '|list ' + domain + '|list my ' + domain, intent_category: 'list_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'get.' + domain + '|get ' + domain + '|find ' + domain, intent_category: 'get_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'update.' + domain + '|update ' + domain + '|edit ' + domain, intent_category: 'update_entity', action_type: 'workflow' }, { pattern: 'delete.' + domain + '|delete ' + domain + '|remove ' + domain, intent_category: 'delete_entity', action_type: 'workflow' } ]; const rootTable = tables.find(function(t) { return !t.foreignKeys || t.foreignKeys.length === 0; }) || tables[0]; const childTables = tables.filter(function(t) { return t.tableName !== rootTable.tableName; }); const joins = childTables.map(function(t) { const alias = t.tableName.replace('PGD_', '').toLowerCase(); const fk = t.foreignKeys && t.foreignKeys[0]; return { type: 'LEFT', table: t.tableName, alias: alias, on: fk ? alias + '.' + fk.column + ' = r.id' : null }; }); const aggregations = childTables.map(function(t) { const alias = t.tableName.replace('PGD_', '').toLowerCase(); const cols = (t.columns || []).filter(function(c) { return c.name !== 'id' && c.name !== 'created_at' && c.name !== 'updated_at'; }).map(function(c) { return c.name; }); return { alias: alias, columns: cols, outputKey: alias }; }); const entitySchemas = [{ entity_name: entityName, description: entityName + ' entity for the ' + domain + ' domain', root_table: rootTable.tableName, domain: domain, joins: joins, aggregations: aggregations, filters: [], upsert_key: [] }]; return { domainHelp: domainHelp, intentMapRows: intentMapRows, entitySchemas: entitySchemas }; })()

name: create_workflow

Right brain researches domain best practices, user confirms preferences, left brain classifies gaps then designs the process and dialogs in separate focused calls, step generator translates to a step array, simulation validates, and the workflow is registered immediately.

steps.description: Format right brain findings and autonomous decisions into a readable summary for the user gate.
steps.expression: (function() { var r = items; var findings = Array.isArray(r.findings) ? r.findings : []; var questions = Array.isArray(r.preference_questions) ? r.preference_questions : []; var lines = []; findings.forEach(function(f) { lines.push('*' + f.topic + '*'); lines.push(f.rationale || f.what_is_known || ''); if (f.recommendation) lines.push('\u2192 ' + f.recommendation); lines.push(''); }); var decisions = findings.filter(function(f) { return f.recommendation; }); var decisionNote = decisions.length > 0 ? decisions.length + ' design decision' + (decisions.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' resolved by research' : 'No autonomous decisions made'; var questionNote = questions.length > 0 ? questions.length + ' preference question' + (questions.length !== 1 ? 's' : '') + ' to follow' : 'No preference questions — proceeding directly to design'; return { summary: lines.join('\n').trim(), decision_note: decisionNote, question_note: questionNote }; })()

name: fix_workflow
description: Tier 1 reactive repair — LLM diagnoses static analysis issues in a registered workflow, proposes corrected steps, validates them, presents a human confirmation gate, writes the fix to PGC_Workflow, updates PGC_SystemContext if needed, and cancels affected runs.

steps.description: Load the current workflow row from PGC_Workflow to get the live steps and version.
Assemble fix_context from supplied input or loaded workflow_row. Normalises the two entry paths into a single shape for downstream steps.
steps.expression: (function() { var inp = local_state.input; var row = (local_state.workflow_row || [])[0] || {}; var allSteps = inp.brokenSteps || row.steps || []; var issueKeys = (inp.issues || []).map(function(i) { return String(i.step); }); var brokenSteps = issueKeys.length > 0 ? allSteps.filter(function(s) { return issueKeys.indexOf(String(s.step)) !== -1; }) : allSteps; return { workflowName: inp.workflowName, issues: inp.issues, brokenSteps: brokenSteps, workflowVersion: inp.workflowVersion != null ? inp.workflowVersion : (row.version != null ? row.version : 1), stackTrace: inp.stackTrace || '' }; })()

steps.description: Right-brain repair call — diagnose root cause, produce corrected step array and optional PGC_SystemContext updates. PGC_SystemContext rows injected automatically via inject_for=fix_workflow_steps.

Merge corrected steps back into the full workflow step array. LLM only returns the fixed steps — this patches them into the complete array so downstream steps and the DB write always work with the full workflow.
steps.expression: (function() { var fullSteps = (local_state.workflow_row || [])[0] ? (local_state.workflow_row[0].steps || []) : []; var corrected = local_state.fix_result ? (local_state.fix_result.corrected_steps || []) : []; var correctedMap = {}; corrected.forEach(function(s) { correctedMap[String(s.step)] = s; }); return fullSteps.map(function(s) { return correctedMap[String(s.step)] || s; }); })()

steps.description: Level 1 static analysis on the full merged step array — validates routing, dead targets, templates, gate structure across all steps. On failure routes to review gate so user sees both the diagnosis and the remaining issues.
Show diagnosis, proposed changes, and (on failure path) remaining validation issues. User confirms to apply the fix or requests another LLM attempt.
Compute the new version number — workflowVersion + 1.

steps.description: Write the fully merged corrected step array and incremented version to PGC_Workflow.

steps.description: Apply each PGC_SystemContext update produced by the LLM — Tier 2 improvement, prevents the same error class from recurring in future workflow generation.
Load all runs in active or failed state for cancellation. Filtering by workflow_id done in the next js_transform since status IN is supported but workflow_id cross-check needs the workflow row.
Load the workflow row to get its id for cross-checking active runs.
Filter active_runs to only those belonging to the repaired workflow, excluding the current fix run itself.

steps.description: Skip cancellation iterator if no active runs to cancel.

name: diagnose_prompt_schema
description: Tier 1b reactive repair — deterministic R1–R7 output_schema and model compatibility fix. Each rule is an independent js_transform step.

steps.description: R1 — array union types → anyOf
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;if(Array.isArray(node.type)){var nonNull=node.type.filter(function(t){return t!=='null';});var hasNull=node.type.indexOf('null')!==-1;var anyOf=nonNull.map(function(t){return{type:t};});if(hasNull)anyOf.push({type:'null'});rs.violations.push({path:path,rule:'R1',description:'array union type ['+node.type.join(',')+'] replaced with anyOf'});delete node.type;node.anyOf=anyOf;}var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R2 — object-typed additionalProperties → false (boolean true/false are valid; only object schemas are rejected)
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;if('additionalProperties'in node&&typeof node.additionalProperties==='object'&&node.additionalProperties!==null){rs.violations.push({path:path,rule:'R2',description:'additionalProperties is object schema '+JSON.stringify(node.additionalProperties)+' — set to false'});node.additionalProperties=false;}var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R3 — add missing additionalProperties:false to objects
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;if(node.type==='object'&&!('additionalProperties'in node)){rs.violations.push({path:path,rule:'R3',description:'object missing additionalProperties: false'});node.additionalProperties=false;}var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R4 — add missing properties:{} to objects
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;if(node.type==='object'&&!('properties'in node)){rs.violations.push({path:path,rule:'R4',description:'object missing properties key'});node.properties={};}var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R5 — add missing required entries
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;if(node.type==='object'&&node.additionalProperties===false&&node.properties){var defined=Object.keys(node.properties);var existing=Array.isArray(node.required)?node.required:[];var missing=defined.filter(function(k){return existing.indexOf(k)===-1;});if(missing.length>0){rs.violations.push({path:path,rule:'R5',description:'properties not in required: ['+missing.join(', ')+']'});node.required=existing.concat(missing);}}var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R6 — apply R3+R4 to anyOf/oneOf/allOf object members
steps.expression: (function(){var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice()};function walk(node,path){if(typeof node!=='object'||node===null)return;['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(!Array.isArray(node[kw]))return;node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){if(typeof m!=='object'||m===null||m.type==='null')return;if(m.type==='object'&&!('additionalProperties'in m)){rs.violations.push({path:path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']',rule:'R6',description:kw+' object member missing additionalProperties: false'});m.additionalProperties=false;}if(m.type==='object'&&!('properties'in m)){rs.violations.push({path:path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']',rule:'R6',description:kw+' object member missing properties key'});m.properties={};}});});var p=node.properties;if(p&&typeof p==='object')Object.keys(p).forEach(function(k){walk(p[k],path+'.properties.'+k);});if(node.items&&typeof node.items==='object')walk(node.items,path+'.items');['anyOf','oneOf','allOf'].forEach(function(kw){if(Array.isArray(node[kw]))node[kw].forEach(function(m,i){walk(m,path+'.'+kw+'['+i+']');});});}walk(rs.schema,'schema');return rs;})()

steps.description: R7 — unsupported model name → anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
steps.expression: (function(){var SUPPORTED=['anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5','perplexity/sonar'];var rs={schema:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(items.schema)),violations:items.violations.slice(),model:items.model};var m=items.model;if(m&&SUPPORTED.indexOf(m)===-1){rs.violations.push({path:'model',rule:'R7',description:'model "'+m+'" is not supported by the Perplexity gateway — must be one of: '+SUPPORTED.join(', '),fixedModel:'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5'});rs.model='anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5';}return rs;})()

steps.description: Aggregate violations, build gate message. Reads repair_state; writes gate_payload.
steps.expression: (function(){var rs=items;var v=rs.violations;if(v.length===0)return{hasViolations:false,gateMessage:'',repairedSchema:rs.schema,violationCount:0};var lines=v.slice(0,10).map(function(x){return '• `'+x.path+'` ['+x.rule+']: '+x.description;});if(v.length>10)lines.push('• …and '+(v.length-10)+' more');var msg=['🔧 *Schema compatibility repair — `'+local_state.input.intentCategory+'`*','','Found *'+v.length+'* violation'+(v.length!==1?'s':'')+':',lines.join('\n'),'','Repair is deterministic. Confirm to apply and retry your workflow.'].join('\n');return{hasViolations:true,gateMessage:msg,repairedSchema:rs.schema,violationCount:v.length};})()

steps.description: Any violations found?
steps.expression: {{gate_payload.hasViolations}}

steps.message_template: {{gate_payload.gateMessage}}

Please retry your workflow.

Check CloudWatch logs for the exact request body.
